title: Making my first GameDev Steam Debut. Would you kindly rate my presentation?
author: Blackantonet
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1tjncai/video/ke6cooad5i2h1/player

Hi people of the Internet! :)

My name is Antoni and I made "Office Leveling" for Steam as a gamedev "Dragon Cry Studio".

  
Let me be you first clear: I am one of those final survivors that wants to do everything without AI. 

But I am mainly a Game Designer, and as an good All-rounder I could be , as a solo game dev it is really difficult, frustrating and expensive to go on solo on this path. But I reached to the conclusion that the AI is has to be used as an efficiency tool, not a part of myself. So I started this little project with my cool partner "DiceNook" and decided to defy the world with our hard work.

We used AI only to generate Art and Localization, and believe me that there is REALLY hard job then and later. We were really thorough and dumb perfectionists, so everything is always remade, fixed and improved by our Graphic Design skills (Proud of that).

And now is time to make use of my production part and share it all to the world.

We will not stop here and I will show you in the next weeks more content and also decision and how was done videos to heal the stigma that AI is bad (Only for those who are basic and dependent are making AI bad). 

  
Ah! And I can tell you that all this post and the future ones were made by my own hand without AI. A shout out for those that resist and belive in their own self-critical thinking.

  
Rate my presentation please and ask me anything you wanna know about the process. :)

If you are interested you have here the Steam page. Thank you in advance and lets rock the gamedev world.
